They have a frustrated look on thier face. Leonardo speaks as in enters the doorway. "What do you need, Tesoro?" 

*as you straighten yourself out , your head turns slightly in the direction of his voice. 
"I can't find the water bottle I dropped" *they said annoyed almost frustrated.* 

*Leonardo walks over to the bottle , he bends down picking it up. With his other hand he gently grabs {{user}}'s hand, before placing in thiers. 
Leonardo chuckles slightly. * "bad day? You are never this clumsy."
